doner.title: Born in Berlin. Stacked by hand in Amiens.
doner.text: In Berlin, kebab comes in golden pide bread with crunchy veg, grilled vegetables and feta. Same here, only closer: veal and turkey marinated for 24 hours, slow-cooked for 3 hours on the spit, stacked every morning.

terrace.title: Right on the Somme.
terrace.text: Quai Belu, in the heart of Saint-Leu. A table outside, the water a few steps away, a Berliner still warm. Simple plan.

fresh.title: Sauces included.
fresh.text: White sauce, gribiche, light garlic, pea, tahini, cocktail: all homemade. So are the fries, and the burger patties come from the butcher.

infos.title: 41 quai Belu.
infos.accessText: In the Saint-Leu quarter, on the banks of the Somme, a 5-minute walk from the cathedral. The quay is pedestrian: come on foot, by bike, or use one of the city-centre car parks.

items.a: Every day from 11:30 am to 11 pm, and until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays. On Wednesdays we take a break from 3:30 to 5:30 pm.
Add your dishes from the menu, choose a pick-up time and send it: we start cooking. You can also call +33 9 55 76 18 32.

items.q: How long does an order take?
items.a: Allow at least 20 minutes: that's the earliest slot offered in the form. At peak times, a quick call lets you check the wait.
At the counter, when you pick up or at the end of your meal.
Yes: falafel Berliner and durum, vegan durum and plate with lentil balls, feta salad, homemade fries. It's all under the "Vegetarian" tab.
Quai Belu is pedestrian. City-centre car parks are a few minutes' walk away; the cathedral right next door makes it easy to find us.

kebab.h1: Kebab in Amiens: the homemade kebab of quai Belu.
kebab.intro: Berlin Durum Kebab is at 41 quai Belu, in the Saint-Leu quarter, on the River Somme. Open every day from 11:30 am to 11 pm (midnight at weekends), to eat in, on the terrace or to take away.

sections.p: The meat, veal and turkey, marinates for 24 hours, then slow-cooks for 3 hours on a spit stacked by hand every day. The fries are cut here, and so are the six sauces: white, gribiche, light garlic, pea, tahini, cocktail.
The Berliner (kebab in pide bread, Berlin-style) from €9.99, durum rolled in a flatbread, plates with homemade fries, burgers with a fresh butcher's patty, salads, and vegetarian and vegan options.
More than 500 customers have left a rating. What they remember: fresh ingredients, the feta, the burrata, the goat cheese with honey, the white sauce and the waterside terrace.
A 5-minute walk from Amiens cathedral, on the pedestrian quay of Saint-Leu. To save time, order online and choose your pick-up time.

doner.title: Berlin döner in Amiens
doner.metaTitle: Berlin döner in Amiens, kebab the Berlin way | Berlin Durum
doner.metaDescription: Berlin-style döner in Amiens: pide bread, homemade kebab, red cabbage, grilled vegetables, feta and homemade white sauce. Berliner from €9.99, quai Belu.
doner.h1: Berlin döner, the quai Belu way.
doner.intro: Döner the way Berlin eats it: generous, crunchy, packed with veg. At Berlin Durum we call it the Berliner, and you'll find it at 41 quai Belu, Amiens.

sections.p: Soft golden pide bread, kebab sliced off the spit, a mountain of fresh veg (lettuce, red and white cabbage), feta, and often grilled vegetables: the Gemüse style that became the signature of Berlin's kebab shops.
Homemade kebab, white sauce, cabbage, grilled courgette, aubergine, carrot and pepper, feta. Our way of saying hello to Kreuzberg. €13.99, or as a meal with homemade fries and a can.
The same filling, rolled in a thin flatbread. The classic durum starts at €9.99, the chef's durum with grilled vegetables is €13.99.
Falafel Berliner and durum, vegan durum and plate with lentil balls: the Berlin style works beautifully without kebab.
